name: wardrobe
label: Wardrobe (one dance, many dancers)
about: One choreography performed by a new character on every beat: bold outfits, seamless studio colour, hard light. Inspired by the Eat It edit.

casting.keep: Keep the exact same pose, body position, arm and leg positions, camera angle, framing and proportions. Full body visible. This one person is alone in the scene. Give the person a completely different face and hair from the original. No glasses. Photorealistic.
